limitations: Spend is derived from RunPod's advertised cost per hour and the pod's observed lifetime, not from an invoice. It is what Merc believes it spent; the provider's own billing is the authority.
Storage and network egress are not included.
withdrawn_reason: image is a mutable tag (vllm/vllm-openai:v0.26.0-cu129-ubuntu2404), not an immutable OCI digest, so the runtime this receipt describes cannot be identified again
the immutable-digest rule was tightened after this receipt was written; the guard deliberately does not grandfather, and re-taking the receipt is impossible because the pod is long gone

the run itself was real and disciplined -- teardown_verified true, no orphan pods, $0.01 against an $18000s budget -- but a spend receipt whose runtime cannot be identified cannot back a cost or performance claim
WITHDRAWN rather than deleted: the paid experiment happened and the record of it stays on disk. It may not be cited as evidence for anything.
